rms.description: Root-mean-square waveform energy, a rough loudness measure

peak.description: Largest absolute waveform sample in the window

pitchHz.description: Rough autocorrelation estimate when a voiced pitch is detectable
pitchHz.limitations: May be null or octave-confused with noise, music, or unvoiced speech

zeroCrossingRate.description: Rate at which waveform crosses zero

heuristic_rules.if: rms > max(0.075, voiceBaseline * 1.22) OR rms/noiseFloor > 6, with sharp spectrum or elevated pitch
rms > max(0.025, voiceBaseline * 1.22) AND (spectralCentroidHz > 1450 OR zeroCrossingRate > 0.105) AND (pitchHz > 145 OR peak > 0.12)

interpretation_warning: These are hand-built acoustic interaction heuristics, not validated emotion recognition. Loudness, pitch and spectral brightness do not reliably reveal anger, sadness, confidence, or intent. Calibrate thresholds to the user's microphone and speaking style.
aggregation: Collects short feature snapshots every 200 ms and aggregates them across a 2-second window (mean RMS/centroid/ZCR/energy, max peak, median detected pitch).

adaptive_thresholds.noiseFloor: Learns a slow background RMS estimate from low-energy windows; bounded between 0.0015 and 0.018
adaptive_thresholds.voiceBaseline: Slowly adapts to plausible speech-level RMS windows
adaptive_thresholds.note: Thresholds are more sensitive than the previous version and should still be calibrated per microphone and environment.

classifier_notes: More sensitive prototype thresholds: quiet RMS <0.006; angry-style cue at RMS >=0.035 or RMS/noise-floor ratio >=3.8 plus spectral brightness, zero-crossing rate, peak, or estimated pitch cue; red alert at RMS >=0.085, ratio >=6.5, or peak >=0.32.
